title: Fight Kaomoji (ง'̀-'́)ง: Copy & Paste Fighting and Gun Faces
meta_description: Copy and paste fight kaomoji: boxing (ง'̀-'́)ง stances, punching faces, sword fighters like ⚔(ò_ó)⚔ and gun kaomoji like (˙ᗜ˙)╦╤─ for games and banter.
hero_tagline: Text faces squaring up, throwing punches, drawing swords and aiming toy guns, for game chat and friendly trash talk. Tap one to copy it.
intro: A fight kaomoji puts something in the face's hands. ง on each side is a fist raised in a boxing guard, 三 or ⊂ in front of a hand is a punch flying out, and box-drawing lines like ╦╤─ or ︻デ═一 build a gun barrel and stock. Swords use ⚔ or a long line of ─ for the blade. These read as cartoon violence, the same as a game character's emote, which is how people use them: to challenge a friend to a match, react to a clutch play, or pretend to defend the last slice of pizza. They are ordinary text, so they paste into game chat, Discord and comments.

sections.label: Boxing
sections.intro: Fists up and ready. The Thai letter ง curls like a raised fist on each side of the face.

sections.label: Punches & Throws
sections.intro: 三 and ≡ are speed lines and ⊃ or つ is the fist, so the punch is mid-swing. ⌒● is a cartoon bomb thrown in an arc.

sections.label: Swords
sections.intro: A blade drawn with ─ or ⚔, for duels, RPG chat and anime moments. ⚔ is crossed swords.

sections.label: Guns
sections.intro: Toy guns built from box-drawing lines. ╦╤─ is a pistol, ︻デ═一 and ︻╦╤─ are rifles. Use them the way you would a water pistol emoji.

faq.a: It is a face with both fists raised in a boxing guard. People send it to say "bring it on", accept a challenge, or show they are ready to tackle something hard.

faq.q: How is a gun kaomoji like (˙ᗜ˙)╦╤─ made?
faq.a: The gun is made of box-drawing characters, which were designed for drawing frames in plain text. ╦ is the grip, ╤ the trigger guard and ─ the barrel. Longer rifles add ︻ and デ for the stock.
Almost never. They are cartoon gestures, used for game challenges, friendly trash talk and dramatic reactions, the same way people use a boxing glove or water pistol emoji.
